description.ja: 「機動戦士ガンダム SEED DESTINY」に登場するカオスガンダムがHGシリーズにラインナップ！ MA形態へ変形可能。ガンポッドのビーム砲は伸縮可能、ミサイルハッチの開閉もパーツの差し替えで再現。ビームライフル、シールド、ビームサーベル×2が付属。
description.en: Chaos Gundam that appears in "Mobile Suit Gundam SEED DESTINY" is now available in the HG series! Can be transformed into MA form. The gun pod's beam cannon can be expanded and contracted, and the opening and closing of the missile hatch can also be recreated by replacing parts. Includes beam rifle, seal, and beam saber x 2.
